Lane width and painted markings are reconstruction estimates. Single central separation line is inferred from opposing mapped carriageways; paint placement is not a contemporary traffic survey.
Road junctions remain open; line paint and curb are cut at mapped crossings.
Yellow building-side arterial curb, dark asphalt and gutter slots are verified by 2025 photographs; exact grate spacing is estimated.
No vegetation is added because mapped/photo evidence does not locate trunks within this crop.
Private service ways retain source tags and are not newly declared accessible.
